<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915304_theRebbe_180" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915304_theRebbe_180__p010">
  <section v="27">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The true purpose of the soul's descent is not for its own ascent through repentance, but for the refinement of the body, animal soul, and one's portion in the world, which is a greater novelty and delight Above.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">20)</t>
    <t s="1">However, despite this,</t>
    <t s="2">the intention of the soul's descent below is not for the ascent of the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">that through its descent below it becomes a baal teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="4">but rather,</t>
    <t s="5">for the refinement and purification of the body, the animal soul, and its portion in the world.</t>
    <t s="6">And this can be explained,</t>
    <t s="7">that the novelty in the repentance of the soul,</t>
    <t s="8">since the soul is literally a part of G-d from above,</t>
    <t s="9">behold, that the soul overcomes the things that conceal,</t>
    <t s="10">and also that it is revealed and acts in the matters of the body and the animal soul itself,</t>
    <t s="11">this is not a true novelty.</t>
    <t s="12">However, the refinement and purification of the body, animal soul, and its portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="13">behold, that they become vessels for G-dliness is a true novelty.</t>
    <t s="14">Therefore, the delight Above</t>
    <t s="15">(which is about a matter of novelty,</t>
    <t s="16">as above)</t>
    <t s="17">from the refinement of the body etc. is a greater delight than the delight that comes from the repentance of the soul.</t>
    <t s="18">[Moreover,</t>
    <t s="19">even when the action of the animal soul is in a manner of repulsion,</t>
    <t s="20">subjugation of the sitra achra,</t>
    <t s="21">there is in this great gratification Above,</t>
    <t s="22">as explained in Tanya.</t>
    <t s="23">And in this itself,</t>
    <t s="24">the main novelty</t>
    <t s="25">(and the gratification Above)</t>
    <t s="26">is in the refinement of his portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="27">for the refinement of the body and animal soul,</t>
    <t s="28">since this is the soul and body of a Jew</t>
    <t s="29">[for even the animal soul and body of a Jew are not like those of the nations of the world],</t>
    <t s="30">is not such a novelty,</t>
    <t s="31">and the main elevation is in the refinement of his portion in the world, and particularly in the refinement of the sparks in inanimate, vegetative, and animal matters</t>
    <t s="32">(through simple repentance, by which intentional sins become like merits,</t>
    <t s="33">and also through trials</t>
    <t s="34">and the like).</t>
    <t s="35">[Based on this, one can also understand what is explained in many places,</t>
    <t s="36">that in order to come to the level of "with all your might" it is through the transformation of darkness into light</t>
    <t s="37">[the darkness of the physical matters that one engages in during the day],</t>
    <t s="38">even though also in the service of "with all your heart" with both inclinations, one transforms the evil inclination to holiness,</t>
    <t s="39">for the main elevation is in the refinement of his portion in the world</t>
    <t s="40">(that is external to him)].</t>
    <t s="41">And this is also "And I will return in peace to my father's house,"</t>
    <t s="42">that the service of subjugation and transformation of darkness into light, which makes the laughter and delight Above</t>
    <t s="43">(the concept of "my father" – Yitzchak)</t>
    <t s="44">is in a manner of "house,"</t>
    <t s="45">meaning that this service of his is in a permanent way</t>
    <t s="46">in all his affairs,</t>
    <t s="47">not only in his body and his animal soul, but also in his portion in the world.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="28">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The main service for which the soul descended is the refinement of worldly matters, as taking the stones of the place, which elevates the physical objects themselves to become a dwelling for the Essential Self of the Ein Sof.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">20)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And based on all the above, it will be understood more deeply that the main service for which the soul descended below</t>
    <t s="3">(and Yaakov went out to Charan)</t>
    <t s="4">is "and he took from the stones of the place,"</t>
    <t s="5">which refers</t>
    <t s="6">(as above in section 9)</t>
    <t s="7">to the refinement of worldly matters,</t>
    <t s="8">for in addition to the advantage of the service of "all your deeds for the sake of Heaven" over the service of Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="9">(as above there),</t>
    <t s="10">behold, even in the service of "all your deeds for the sake of Heaven" itself, there are two matters,</t>
    <t s="11">the ascent of the person that is brought about by this</t>
    <t s="12">(repentance of the soul),</t>
    <t s="13">and the elevation of the physical things.</t>
    <t s="14">And in these two matters,</t>
    <t s="15">the main service is "and he took from the stones of the place,"</t>
    <t s="16">the refinement of physical things,</t>
    <t s="17">the stones of the place.</t>
    <t s="18">And this is also what is written: "And Havayah will be for me a G-d, and this stone which I have set as a pillar will be a house of G-d."</t>
    <t s="19">"And Havayah will be for me a G-d" is the elevation that occurs in the person through the service of refinements,</t>
    <t s="20">and afterwards he adds, "and this stone which I have set as a pillar will be a house of G-d,"</t>
    <t s="21">that even this stone,</t>
    <t s="22">the physical things themselves that were initially "stones of the place" in the plural, and through the service of the person become one stone</t>
    <t s="23">[and in a manner of "I have set as a pillar" from the term "standing"</t>
    <t s="24">king,</t>
    <t s="25">that he becomes the master</t>
    <t s="26">(king)</t>
    <t s="27">over all his affairs of his portion in the world.</t>
    <t s="28">And also the interpretation of "pillar" from the term "standing king,"</t>
    <t s="29">that he draws down in them the revelation of His kingship,</t>
    <t s="30">the aspect of His kingship they accepted upon themselves willingly</t>
    <t s="31">(which is above the aspect of dominion that is by force)],</t>
    <t s="32">will be a house of G-d,</t>
    <t s="33">that they will be a house and dwelling for G-d, who is above Havayah</t>
    <t s="34">(even more than "Havayah will be for me a G-d"</t>
    <t s="35">which is from the aspect of repentance of the soul of G-d),</t>
    <t s="36">to the essential concealment of His Essential Self.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="29">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through taking the stone, setting it as a pillar, and pouring oil on its head, the stone becomes a house of G-d, drawing down from levels above the Thirteen Attributes, leading to the future redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">20)</t>
    <t s="1">B)</t>
    <t s="2">And in order that "this stone will be a house of G-d," it is through the service of "and he took the stone and set it as a pillar and poured oil on its head."</t>
    <t s="3">"And he took the stone" in the singular,</t>
    <t s="4">meaning,</t>
    <t s="5">that even after he made from the stones of the place</t>
    <t s="6">(plural)</t>
    <t s="7">one stone,</t>
    <t s="8">analogous to the yud of the Name Havayah, the aspect of Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="9">he elevated it higher</t>
    <t s="10">("and set it as a pillar,"</t>
    <t s="11">like the concept of "arose"</t>
    <t s="12">my sheaf and also stood upright)</t>
    <t s="13">to the aspect of the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy Above, which are the aspect of yudins and vavins.</t>
    <t s="14">For there is a vav that is lower than the yud, and there is a vav that is higher than the yud</t>
    <t s="15">[therefore it is brought in Torah Ohr</t>
    <t s="16">(at the beginning of the topic)</t>
    <t s="17">that the hair itself is the aspect of vav, and the place of its source is the aspect of yud – even though at the end of the topic</t>
    <t s="18">he concludes there that the vav is above the yud – because there are two concepts in this].</t>
    <t s="19">And afterwards, "and poured oil on its head,"</t>
    <t s="20">that he drew down into it from a level above the Thirteen Attributes.</t>
    <t s="21">And through this, "and this stone will be a house of G-d,"</t>
    <t s="22">"will be" in the masculine</t>
    <t s="23">(even though it said "this stone" in the feminine),</t>
    <t s="24">for it refers to the revelation of the future redemption, when there will be a new song in the masculine</t>
    <t s="25">(a redemption after which there is no exile).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
